home.hero_desc: Center for fundamental and applied research in the energy sector, alternative energy sources and improving energy efficiency.
home.about_title: A national center of energy science in Uzbekistan
home.about_p1: The Institute of Energy Problems is a leading research institution within the Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Uzbekistan. It conducts fundamental and applied research in energy systems, alternative energy sources and energy efficiency.
home.about_p2: Our laboratories work on solar and wind energy, smart grids and energy-saving technologies. The institute’s specialists take an active part in providing the scientific basis for the country’s energy policy.
home.contact_desc: Get in touch with us for scientific collaboration, questions and proposals.
home.about_img_alt: Wind energy farm — alternative energy sources

about.title: About the Institute
about.mission_text: Our institute conducts fundamental and applied scientific research aimed at solving energy problems of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
about.history_text: The institute was established within the Academy of Sciences of Uzbekistan and has achieved many important scientific milestones in the energy sector.
about.research_areas: Research laboratories and areas of study
about.history_extra: The institute operates under the structure approved by the Presidium of the Academy of Sciences on 27 February 2025.
